name: Dice and chance
author: Alfie
description: Rolls dice (like 2d6+3 or 4d6 keep 3), flips coins, picks something at random from a list, shuffles lists and draws playing cards. Fair randomness from your computer, for board games, role-playing and deciding where to eat.

tools.name: roll_dice
tools.description: Roll dice written in dice notation, e.g. d20, 2d6+3, 4d6k3 (keep the highest 3), 2d20kl1 (keep the lowest, disadvantage), d%, 3d6-1. Several rolls can be separated with commas.

tools.name: pick_random
tools.description: Pick one or more things at random from a list (without repeats), or shuffle the whole list.

shuffle.description: Return the whole list in random order instead

tools.name: random_number
tools.description: A random whole number between min and max (both included).

tools.name: draw_cards
tools.description: Draw playing cards from a freshly shuffled 52-card deck (optionally with two jokers).

prompt: Never make up a roll, flip or random pick yourself: always use these tools so the result is really random, and tell the user the result plainly.
